items.title: VPN服務商Surfshark內部測試伺服器遭駭，未波及用戶資料
items.summary: VPN與網路安全服務商Surfshark於9月9日揭露資安事件，該公司內部測試伺服器因配置錯誤暴露於網際網路，遭攻擊者存取，該伺服器屬工程測試環境，與提供Surfshark VPN等服務的正式環境分離，未儲存或處理用戶資料，因此沒有用戶受到影響，也未造成VPN服務、流量或瀏覽活動資訊外洩。

items.title: 祖克柏談AI安全，各家業者應自行確保模型安全
items.summary: Meta執行長祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）周二（9/15）透過X談及AI安全，認為各家AI實驗室都有責任及誘因，以確保模型安全所需的步調發展，並應自行採取必要的安全措施。

items.title: Mozilla發布Firefox 156，修補73個資安漏洞
items.summary: Mozilla於9月15日發布Firefox瀏覽器156版，並修補73個漏洞，包含29個高風險漏洞。就漏洞涉及的元件來看，這次Firefox修補以圖形相關元件最多，包括Graphics與Graphics: CanvasWebGL在內合計有15個漏洞；次之是Widget: Win32與Networking，各有6個與4個漏洞。

items.title: 美國加密貨幣監管法案CLARITY Act參議院闖關失敗
items.summary: 美國參議院周二（9/15）表決加密貨幣監管法案《CLARITY Act》，最終僅獲49票支持、50票反對，未達推進法案所需的60票門檻。法案闖關失敗後，比特幣一度跌破7.5萬美元，以太幣跌逾5%，XRP更重挫逾10%。 CLARITY Act主要是用來建立美國加密貨幣市場監管架構，包括釐清證券交易委員會（SEC）與商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）的監管權責，以及加密貨幣業者應遵循的規範，眾議院已於去年7月通過該法案，兩黨經過數月協商仍未取得共識，在參議院被擋了下來。

items.title: fix(agents): fence context engine bootstrap at the admitted user turn…
items.summary: fix(agents): fence context engine bootstrap at the admitted user turn (#149690) The embedded runner persists the current user turn before bootstrapping the context engine, but only the assemble call ran under the transcript read fence. An engine that reconciles from the transcript imported the pending turn, the host appended it again after assembly, and the next run kept one copy, so every later provider byte shifted and the prompt cache missed. Co-authored-by: Peter Lindsey

items.title: fix(worktrees): preserve work during creation and cleanup races (#149…
items.summary: fix(worktrees): preserve work during creation and cleanup races (#149914) Pin checkout sizing and materialization to the commit Git actually registers, while retaining native upstream tracking and submodule behavior. Keep rollback under allocation ownership after caller cancellation and fence it after lease loss or a changed Git registration. Serialize orphan cleanup and snapshot expiry with creation and restore, recheck activity before cleanup, and use the actual allocation outcome for session rollback. Recover Git locks after registry errors, handle stale origin/HEAD and nested working directories, and remove unused branch and lease machinery.

items.title: fix(ui): stabilize browser interaction coverage (#149929)
items.summary: fix(ui): stabilize browser interaction coverage (#149929) A cold single-worker browser run exposed platform and stylesheet-order failures in Control UI coverage. Use the host's undo modifier, deterministic selection and pointer interactions, and complete theme-state ownership while keeping annotation button shadows scoped to the chat owner. Validation: Node passed all 56 affected browser tests; the signed Bun build passed the complete 936-test browser lane; exact-head CI, the changed-file gate, visual proof, ClawSweeper review, and P0-P2 autoreview passed.
